subject: Fenwick Logistics: bank account change and fulfillment hub update
messages:
From: Eleanor Barnes <eleanor@fenwicklogistics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounting@fenwicklogistics.com
Date: Tue, 07 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fenwick Logistics — bank account change & fulfillment hub update

Hi Marcus,

Quick heads-up from AP — Fenwick Logistics is changing our primary receiving bank and relocating our UK fulfillment hub. Effective for invoices dated on or after 2027-06-15, please update the vendor remit details and the ship-to for POs that target our UK facility.

What’s attached:
- bank_letter_fenwick_202706.pdf (bank-provided confirmation of new account, includes SWIFT/BIC)
- remittance_update_form_fenwick_202706.pdf (completed by our finance team)
- manifest_fulfillment_hubs.csv (mapping of existing PO ship-to codes to new hub address)

Immediate asks:
1) Can you confirm the process you need from us for Redwood to rekey the vendor record (ACH/wire details)?
2) We have PO PO-8742 and a handful of outstanding invoices due next week — please advise if you need expedited verification to avoid payment delays.

Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Thanks,
Eleanor Barnes
Accounts Payable 
Fenwick Logistics
[Attachment: bank_letter_fenwick_202706.pdf (pdf; 310 KB)]
[Attachment: remittance_update_form_fenwick_202706.pdf (pdf; 120 KB)]
[Attachment: manifest_fulfillment_hubs.csv (csv; 8 KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eleanor Barnes <eleanor@fenwicklogistics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fenwick Logistics — bank account change & fulfillment hub update

Hi Eleanor —

Thanks for the heads-up and for sending the documentation. We can support the change but need a couple of items before our AP team will rekey:

- Completed vendor portal update (we prefer the portal form so changes hit our system of record). If you can upload that, please use the Vendor Portal link provided at the bottom.
- A signed W-9 or equivalent tax form for the entity on file (we couldn't find a current W-9 attached).
- Clarify whether you want ACH or wire as the primary payment method going forward.

For PO PO-8742: if you can confirm which invoices need priority, we will flag them for expedited verification once the portal form + W-9 are in place.

Monica/Grace — can you pick this up for rekey and supplier verification? Monica, please run the bank-letter validation and mark any exceptions; Grace, please coordinate the portal update with Fenwick and confirm the ship-to mapping for POs that route to the UK hub.

Eleanor — if it's easier, I'm available for a 20-minute call this afternoon (2–4pm PT).

Best,
Marcus Lin
Vendor Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
[Vendor Portal: https://vendor.redwoodinference.com/portal/upload]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Fenwick Logistics — bank account change & fulfillment hub update (internal)

Forwarding the docs from Fenwick — they included a bank confirmation and a remittance form. I ran an initial check on the SWIFT and account name; we still need:

- a completed vendor portal submission (their AP team indicated they would upload but we haven't received it yet)
- a signed tax form (W-9) for our records
- a short authorization email from Fenwick on letterhead confirming effective date of 2027-06-15 for the bank switch

Action items:
- Marcus: please author the rekey request ticket to Finance with a priority flag for PO-8742 and attach the bank letter.
- Grace: when Fenwick uploads the portal form, please validate the remit fields and update the ship-to mapping (see their manifest_fulfillment_hubs.csv). If the UK hub mapping requires a new GL/PO route, we'll coordinate with Ops.

Note on verification: Finance requires either: 1) bank confirmation letter (we have), plus 2) a signed W-9 or equivalent. If Fenwick can't provide a W-9, we'll need additional ID verification and may delay automatic cutover.

Thanks — I'll stand by to run the validation once the portal upload and W-9 arrive.

Monica
Senior Procurement Analyst
Redwood Inference

Hi Eleanor —

Thanks again for the materials and patience while our team validated the details. Confirming the update is complete as of today for Redwood's vendor master:

- Payment method: Primary = ACH (new account ending ••4321). We have ingested the bank confirmation letter and validated bank/SWIFT information with Finance.
- Tax form: Received signed W-9 via portal and attached here for your reference.
- Effective date: 2027-06-15 for new bank; we've set our pay-cycle to honor invoices with invoice_date >= 2027-06-15 to the new account.
- Ship-to mapping: UK fulfillment hub updated per your manifest; POs routed to HUB-UK-A now point to the new address and will flow to the correct receiving workflow.

For PO PO-8742 we flagged the outstanding invoices and Finance will release payment on the next AP run (expected 2027-06-18). If you expect any additional invoices that should be prioritized, please reply with invoice numbers and we will escalate.

Attachments: vendor_portal_update_fenwick_20270609.pdf (filled portal submission), signed_w9_fenwick_20270609.pdf.

If anything else pops up, loop me in and we’ll take care of it.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Vendor Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
